record.paper_title: Properly Coloured Cycles and Paths: Results and Open Problems
record.context_brief: Asymptotic threshold for properly coloured cycles
record.original_question: For each fixed integer c ≥ 2, determine whether there exists a constant s(c) depending only on c such that, as n grows, the minimum integer d(n,c) with the property that every c-edge-coloured graph on n vertices and minimum monochromatic degree at least d(n,c) contains a properly coloured cycle satisfies d(n,c) = s(c) log_2 n (1 + o(1)).

evidence.quote: Conjecture 2.2. [15] There is a function s(c) dependent only on c such that d(n, c) = s(c) log2 n(1 + o(1)).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G be a finite simple graph on n vertices whose edges are coloured with c colours (c ≥ 2 an integer), where edges of different colours may share endpoints. For a vertex v and a colour i, let d_i(v) denote the number of edges of colour i incident to v. Define the minimum monochromatic degree of G as δ^mon(G) = min_{v ∈ V(G)} min_{1 ≤ i ≤ c} d_i(v). A cycle in G is called properly coloured if every two consecutive edges along it have distinct colours.

For fixed c ≥ 2 and each positive integer n, let d(n,c) be the smallest integer d such that every c-edge-coloured graph on n vertices with δ^mon(G) ≥ d contains a properly coloured cycle.

Determine whether there exists a constant s(c), depending only on c, such that
    d(n,c) = s(c) · log_2 n · (1 + o(1))     as n → ∞,
and if so, identify s(c).
artifact.category_tag: edge-coloured graphs and properly coloured cycles
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not locate a resolution of this asymptotic conjecture for the minimum monochromatic degree threshold guaranteeing a properly coloured cycle in c-edge-coloured graphs. Related work establishes partial monochromatic-degree conditions in edge-coloured complete graphs but does not confirm the conjectured s(c) log_2 n asymptotic. The conjecture appears to still be open.

status_evidence.title: Monochromatic-degree conditions for properly colored cycles in edge-colored complete graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Studies monochromatic-degree conditions ensuring properly coloured cycles, but does not establish the conjectured logarithmic asymptotic for general edge-coloured graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Related results give partial monochromatic-degree conditions, not the asymptotic d(n,c) = s(c) log_2 n.

status_evidence.title: Properly colored cycles in edge-colored complete graphs without monochromatic triangle
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates existence of properly coloured cycles under structural assumptions on edge-colourings.
status_evidence.claim: Confirms ongoing investigation of properly coloured cycle existence but does not settle the asymptotic threshold conjecture.
